description: Opt-in per-venue model for the v1.12 cost-aware router (iap.execution.sor_v2). Keyed by venue name from venues.json (which is unchanged). p_fill_touch: P(fill) for an order joining the touch (a calibration document's fill_rates override it); toxicity_bps: maker adverse selection by markout horizon, positive = adverse; fee_tiers: monthly-volume tiers, first tier at 0 shares. Synthetic, indicative values.
